info.title: scopelogix
info.description: ScopeLogix CLI — authenticate and import estimates from JSON files.

commands.name: login
commands.description: Authenticate against the ScopeLogix API and save credentials locally.

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the ScopeLogix API (e.g. https://api.scopelogix.com).

commands.name: import
commands.description: Import an estimate from a JSON file into ScopeLogix.

options.name: --file
options.description: Path to the estimate JSON import file.

options.name: --url
options.description: Override the API base URL (uses saved credentials by default).

commands.name: example
commands.description: Write the latest bundled example estimate JSON file to disk.

options.name: --output
options.description: Path to write the example file to (default: ./sample-estimate.json).

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the target file if it already exists without prompting.
